title: Lab 2D part 2 — Lambda stats uploader → Aurora
topic: Lambda in VPC, ENI cold start, Secrets Manager DB credentials, SQS event source mapping, Aurora writer endpoint UPSERT, DynamoDB vs relational for GSA
format: 15 timed scenario questions (~24 min, ~96 sec each). Reinforces night-17-lambda-aurora.md and night-17-lab-lambda-stats-setup scripts. Answer without peeking at night-17-quiz-answers.json first.
answerDistribution: A×4 B×4 C×4 D×3 — options shuffled so correct letter varies

questions.question: night-17-lab deploys saa-study-gsa-stats-uploader in Night 9 private subnets with saa-study-gsa-lambda-stats-sg. Aurora saa-study-gsa-aurora-sg already allows TCP 5432 from lambda-stats-sg. What additional SG rule does the Lambda security group need for PostgreSQL writes?

options.A: Inbound TCP 5432 from aurora-sg so Aurora can push query result sets back to Lambda
options.B: No inbound rule — Lambda initiates outbound TCP 5432 to the Aurora writer endpoint
options.C: Inbound TCP 443 from 0.0.0.0/0 so Secrets Manager works over the public internet
options.D: Inbound TCP 5432 from the entire VPC CIDR 10.0.0.0/16 to support Multi-AZ failover

questions.question: The stats uploader runs INSERT … ON CONFLICT to increment monthly_runs in resort_stats. Which Aurora endpoint must DB_HOST point to?

options.A: Custom Route 53 CNAME you create for the current Aurora reader instance hostname
options.B: RDS Data API HTTPS endpoint enabled on the cluster for all INSERT and SELECT calls
options.C: Cluster reader endpoint — load-balanced path for both SELECT queries and INSERT writes
options.D: Cluster writer endpoint — all writes and default primary reads go to the writer

questions.question: First -TestInvoke after create-function takes 30+ seconds while later invokes finish in a few seconds. What is the most likely cause?

options.A: Lambda VPC attachment creates or attaches ENIs in private subnets on cold start
options.B: Aurora Serverless v2 scales to zero and must cold-start the database engine first
options.C: SQS long polling blocks the synchronous invoke until a completion message arrives
options.D: Secrets Manager rotates the master password on every GetSecretValue API call

questions.question: night-17-lab stores DB_SECRET_ARN in environment variables and calls secretsmanager:GetSecretValue at runtime. Why not put the master password directly in DB_PASSWORD?

options.A: Lambda environment variables cannot exceed 4 KB total size across all key/value pairs
options.B: PostgreSQL rejects passwords delivered via environment variables over the TCP session
options.C: Secrets Manager supports rotation and audit; plaintext env vars leak in console and logs
options.D: Aurora ManageMasterUserPassword only works with RDS Data API clients, not with TCP drivers

questions.question: Night 13 queue saa-study-gsa-iceland-completion has VisibilityTimeout=60. The Lambda timeout is 30 seconds. Is this pairing valid for the event source mapping?

options.A: No — visibility timeout must exactly equal the configured Lambda function timeout
options.B: No — visibility timeout must be shorter so DLQ redrive triggers after each failure faster
options.C: Yes — visibility timeout should be at least Lambda timeout so the message stays hidden
options.D: Yes — but only if the queue is FIFO with content-based deduplication enabled on sends

questions.question: An SQS message body contains the full ECS Task State Change JSON from Night 13 EventBridge. The handler has no resort_id field. What should the uploader do in this study lab?

options.A: Reject the message immediately and send it directly to the DLQ without any retry attempts
options.B: Parse taskArn and call ECS DescribeTasks to read container environment overrides
options.C: Treat Iceland completion as the default IS-001 resort row UPSERT for this study lab
options.D: Forward the raw ECS JSON to Aurora using RDS Data API batch_execute_statement for inserts

questions.question: Lambda in private subnets must reach Secrets Manager and CloudWatch Logs. Night 9 VPC uses a NAT Gateway in the public subnet. What happens if you remove the NAT route from the private subnet route table?

options.A: Outbound calls to AWS APIs fail unless VPC interface endpoints replace the NAT path
options.B: Lambda still reaches Secrets Manager because Aurora security groups allow AWS API egress
options.C: Database TCP 5432 continues working but SQS event source polling stops permanently
options.D: Lambda automatically uses the RDS Data API instead of NAT for all AWS service calls

questions.question: GSA wiki page views use DynamoDB UpdateItem ADD on a partition key. resort_stats monthly aggregates need SQL JOIN reports. Where should each workload live?

options.A: DynamoDB for simple counters; Aurora for relational stats and SQL JOIN queries
options.B: Both in Aurora — use JSON columns in PostgreSQL for high-volume page view counters
options.C: Both in DynamoDB — store resort_stats as a single-item document per resort_id key
options.D: S3 CSV files for both — Athena replaces DynamoDB and Aurora for all metric queries

questions.question: You add fifty concurrent Lambda pollers on the same completion queue without RDS Proxy. Aurora reports too many connections. What is the exam-best mitigation?

options.A: Increase Lambda memory to 10 GB so each execution reuses one persistent DB connection
options.B: Open the Aurora security group to 0.0.0.0/0 so connections distribute across the internet
options.C: Switch INSERT statements to the reader endpoint to split write connection load evenly
options.D: Place RDS Proxy between Lambda and Aurora to pool and multiplex database connections

questions.question: night-17-lab bundles pg8000 in the deployment package instead of using RDS Data API from Lambda. Why choose VPC TCP for this lab path?

options.A: RDS Data API cannot run INSERT statements against Aurora PostgreSQL writer endpoints
options.B: Exam scenarios often test Lambda-in-VPC plus SG-referenced DB access on port 5432
options.C: Data API requires public accessibility enabled on the Aurora instance for HTTPS calls
options.D: pg8000 is the only PostgreSQL driver the AWS Lambda Python runtime includes by default

questions.question: After -TestInvoke succeeds, -VerifyRow uses aws rds-data execute-statement from your laptop. Why can the laptop query resort_stats while the uploader uses pg8000 over TCP?

options.A: VerifyRow connects through the Lambda ENI using SSM Session Manager port forwarding
options.B: RDS Data API uses HTTPS with cluster ARN + Secrets Manager — no VPC path from laptop
options.C: The writer endpoint is temporarily public only while the VerifyRow script is running
options.D: Aurora automatically mirrors Data API results to a public read replica for laptop access

questions.question: night-17-lab-lambda-stats-teardown.ps1 deletes the function and IAM role but leaves Aurora and SQS. A teammate runs Night 16 teardown next. What breaks for Night 13 consumers?

options.A: Nothing — SQS and EventBridge rules are independent of the Aurora study cluster
options.B: Night 13 queue is deleted automatically when the Aurora cluster is removed from the account
options.C: EventBridge stops publishing because Aurora was registered as the event source for ECS
options.D: DLQ messages replay into the deleted Lambda and permanently block the completion queue

questions.question: The handler uses ON CONFLICT (resort_id) DO UPDATE to increment monthly_runs. Which property makes this safe when SQS delivers duplicate completion messages?

options.A: SQS FIFO guarantees exactly-once delivery without needing MessageDeduplicationId values
options.B: Lambda event source mapping deletes messages from the queue before invoking the function
options.C: Aurora reader endpoint deduplicates concurrent INSERT statements across all connections
options.D: Standard SQS is at-least-once — idempotent UPSERT prevents double-count corruption

questions.question: You need sub-second wiki view counter updates globally with no JOINs. Iceland batch completion runs once per month. Which storage and trigger pairing fits?

options.A: Aurora for wiki views; SQS triggers a monthly Lambda that updates counter rows only
options.B: DynamoDB for wiki views; SQS → Lambda → Aurora for monthly batch resort_stats writes
options.C: ElastiCache for both workloads — flush counter and stats data to S3 nightly for BI
options.D: RDS Multi-AZ provisioned instance for wiki views; EventBridge writes directly to DynamoDB

questions.question: Create-function fails with EC2 502 when attaching VpcConfig immediately after creating the IAM role. What is the first fix to try?

options.A: Enable public accessibility on the Aurora cluster so Lambda VPC ENI creation can succeed
options.B: Change the Lambda runtime from python3.12 to python3.9 for better VPC ENI compatibility
options.C: Wait for IAM role propagation, then retry create-function or update-function-configuration
options.D: Remove Secrets Manager permissions — VPC-attached Lambdas cannot call Secrets Manager APIs
